metadata.description: Claude Code plugins for Base44 builders, by Daniel Rechtman.

plugins.name: base44-phone-sso
plugins.description: Set up phone-number login (WhatsApp OTP via Green API) for a Base44 app, end-to-end. Deploys a self-hosted OIDC provider on Cloudflare, connects it to Base44 SSO, and adds an in-app allowlist of approved numbers.
